title: Characters don't align with the 1280x720 resolution in MZ .

posts.author: StephBells
posts.body:
I changed my game's resolution, and I need the characters to align as they should in the combat scene. Do you have any solution for this?
Thank you.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
StephBells said:
I did search google before asking, that's why I'm here. Not one seems to have a solution.
Click to expand...
That search guided me to a
forum thread
that indicates the use of the SVActorPositionMZ.js plugin, which seems to let you change the defaults actor side view positions on the battle.
Plugin is on your default MZ installed folder, under:
dlc > BasicResource > plugins > launch
That is not what you want?
